messages:
olivia: FYI platform will stop honoring legacy `X-Route-Info` in two weeks and prefers `X-RW-Route-Policy` (compact json). want to coordinate SDK behavior so quota/console mapping stays intact.

trevor: is platform dual-writing during the window or is it a hard cut?

olivia: dual-write for 72h only at rollout start, then new-only. they asked SDKs to mirror/normalize to the new header when possible.

maya: suggestion: SDKs add a tiny normalization middleware that reads any legacy header, unquotes if necessary, maps fields, and sets `X-RW-Route-Policy`. also emit a low-sample telemetry counter `sdk.header.normalize` with {from:old|new, parsed:true|false}. sampling 0.01 by default.

den: agree. we should gate with RW_ROUTE_MIGRATE=canary|stable|off and include a unit test for the quoted-json edge case. planning: open PRs, canary release, land dual-write monitoring, flip default.

infra-bot: canary pipeline started for sdk-go @ 1760000030 :rocket:

olivia: console will add a small reconciliation tile (sampled events vs inferred routes). trevor can you own an alert if mismatch > 0.5% for 5m?

trevor: on it. I'll also add a note for support playbook in case customers set raw headers manually.

maya: I'll draft the cross-SDK snippets (py/ts/go) and push PRs today. keep reactions for owners. :thumbsup:
